tip_vi: Bong bóng đề cập đến cả bong bóng và cũng có thể được sử dụng như một phép ẩn dụ cho bong bóng giá tài sản.
tip_fr: Bulle fait référence aux deux bulles et peut également être utilisée comme métaphore des bulles des prix des actifs.

senses.en: to make something more attractive by adding beautiful things
senses.vi: to make something more attractive by adding beautiful things

senses.en: to paint walls or cover them with wallpaper
senses.vi: to paint walls or cover them with wallpaper

ex.en: We decorated the balcony with colourful pots and tiny lights.
ex.zh: 我们用彩色花盆和小灯装饰了阳台。
ex.vi: We decorated the balcony with colourful pots and tiny lights.
ex.fr: Nous avons décoré le balcon avec des pots colorés et de petites lumières.

ex.en: Allowing students to decorate shared learning spaces may increase their sense of ownership and responsibility.
ex.zh: 允许学生装饰公共学习空间，可能增强他们的主人翁意识和责任感。
ex.vi: Allowing students to decorate shared learning spaces may increase their sense of ownership and responsibility.
ex.fr: Permettre aux étudiants de décorer des espaces d’apprentissage partagés peut accroître leur sentiment d’appartenance et de responsabilité.

tip: decorate A with B表示用B装饰A。
tip_vi: trang trí A bằng B có nghĩa là trang trí A bằng B.
tip_fr: décorer A avec B signifie décorer A avec B.
col_fr: décorer avec des fleurs｜decorate with flowers

senses.en: A dish of meat or vegetables cooked slowly in liquid.
senses.vi: A dish of meat or vegetables cooked slowly in liquid.

senses.en: To cook slowly in liquid over gentle heat.
senses.vi: To cook slowly in liquid over gentle heat.

ex.en: We shared a bowl of vegetable stew after our walk.
ex.zh: 散步后，我们一起吃了一碗炖蔬菜。
ex.vi: We shared a bowl of vegetable stew after our walk.
ex.fr: Nous avons partagé un bol de ragoût de légumes après notre promenade.

ex.en: Traditional stews can provide affordable, nutritious meals while making effective use of locally grown vegetables.
ex.zh: 传统炖菜可以充分利用本地种植的蔬菜，提供经济实惠又营养丰富的餐食。
ex.vi: Traditional stews can provide affordable, nutritious meals while making effective use of locally grown vegetables.
ex.fr: Les ragoûts traditionnels peuvent fournir des repas nutritifs et abordables tout en utilisant efficacement les légumes cultivés localement.

tip: stew既可指炖菜，也可作动词表示慢炖。
tip_vi: Stew có thể ám chỉ món hầm, hoặc nó cũng có thể được dùng như một động từ để chỉ việc nấu chậm.
tip_fr: Ragoût peut faire référence au ragoût, ou il peut également être utilisé comme verbe pour désigner une cuisson lente.

senses.en: someone who creates a device or process not previously existing
senses.vi: someone who creates a device or process not previously existing

ex.en: The inventor showed us a lamp powered by sunlight.
ex.zh: 这位发明家向我们展示了一盏太阳能灯。
ex.vi: The inventor showed us a lamp powered by sunlight.
ex.fr: L'inventeur nous a montré une lampe alimentée par la lumière du soleil.

ex.en: Inventors often need financial support to turn promising ideas into practical technologies that benefit society.
ex.zh: 发明者往往需要资金支持，才能把有前景的想法转化为造福社会的实用技术。
ex.vi: Inventors often need financial support to turn promising ideas into practical technologies that benefit society.
ex.fr: Les inventeurs ont souvent besoin d’un soutien financier pour transformer des idées prometteuses en technologies pratiques qui profitent à la société.

tip: inventor创造新事物；discoverer发现已有事物。
tip_vi: Nhà phát minh tạo ra những thứ mới; người khám phá khám phá những thứ hiện có.
tip_fr: Les inventeurs créent de nouvelles choses ; les découvreurs découvrent des choses existantes.
col_zh: 杰出的发明家｜a brilliant inventor
有志成为发明家的人｜an aspiring inventor

senses.en: The capital city of the Philippines.
senses.vi: The capital city of the Philippines.

ex.en: Our flight landed in Manila just before sunset.
ex.zh: 我们的航班在日落前不久降落在马尼拉。
ex.vi: Our flight landed in Manila just before sunset.
ex.fr: Notre vol a atterri à Manille juste avant le coucher du soleil.

ex.en: Coastal cities such as Manila need resilient infrastructure to reduce the risks associated with flooding.
ex.zh: 马尼拉等沿海城市需要有韧性的基础设施，以降低洪水带来的风险。
ex.vi: Coastal cities such as Manila need resilient infrastructure to reduce the risks associated with flooding.
ex.fr: Les villes côtières comme Manille ont besoin d’infrastructures résilientes pour réduire les risques associés aux inondations.

col: a flight to Manila｜a flight to Manila
tip: 城市名须大写；小写manila通常指马尼拉纸等材料。
note: 按所给城市义将首字母改为大写：Manila。
tip_vi: Tên thành phố phải viết hoa; manila chữ thường thường đề cập đến các vật liệu như giấy manila.
tip_fr: Le nom de la ville doit être en majuscule ; manille minuscule fait généralement référence à des matériaux tels que le papier manille.
col_zh: 飞往马尼拉的航班｜a flight to Manila
col_fr: un vol pour Manille｜a flight to Manila

senses.en: Not allowed by law
senses.vi: Not allowed by law

ex.en: It is illegal to park here overnight without permission.
ex.zh: 未经许可在这里通宵停车是违法的。
ex.vi: It is illegal to park here overnight without permission.
ex.fr: Il est illégal de stationner ici la nuit sans autorisation.

ex.en: Stronger international cooperation is needed to prevent illegal fishing and protect vulnerable marine ecosystems.
ex.zh: 需要加强国际合作，以防止非法捕捞并保护脆弱的海洋生态系统。
ex.vi: Stronger international cooperation is needed to prevent illegal fishing and protect vulnerable marine ecosystems.
ex.fr: Une coopération internationale plus forte est nécessaire pour prévenir la pêche illégale et protéger les écosystèmes marins vulnérables.

tip: 常用句型：It is illegal to do sth.。
tip_vi: Các mẫu câu thông dụng: Làm việc gì đó là vi phạm pháp luật..
tip_fr: Modèles de phrases courants : Il est illégal de faire quelque chose.
col_zh: 将某事定为违法｜make something illegal
col_fr: rendre quelque chose d'illégal｜make something illegal

senses.en: a competition to decide the best player or team
senses.vi: a competition to decide the best player or team

senses.en: the position or title of being a champion
senses.vi: the position or title of being a champion

ex.en: Our school team reached the final of the championship.
ex.zh: 我们校队打进了锦标赛的决赛。
ex.vi: Our school team reached the final of the championship.
ex.fr: Notre équipe scolaire a atteint la finale du championnat.

ex.en: Hosting an international championship can attract visitors, but the cost of new facilities may burden local taxpayers.
ex.zh: 举办国际锦标赛可以吸引游客，但新建设施的费用可能加重当地纳税人的负担。
ex.vi: Hosting an international championship can attract visitors, but the cost of new facilities may burden local taxpayers.
ex.fr: L'organisation d'un championnat international peut attirer des visiteurs, mais le coût des nouvelles installations peut peser sur les contribuables locaux.

tip: 既可指争夺冠军的赛事，也可指冠军头衔。
tip_vi: Nó có thể đề cập đến cả cuộc cạnh tranh cho chức vô địch và danh hiệu vô địch.
tip_fr: Il peut désigner à la fois la compétition pour le championnat et le titre de champion.

senses.en: a particular time when something happens
senses.vi: a particular time when something happens

senses.en: an important or special event
senses.vi: an important or special event

senses.en: a suitable opportunity to do something
senses.vi: a suitable opportunity to do something

ex.en: I have met your sister on several occasions.
ex.zh: 我见过你姐姐好几次。
ex.vi: I have met your sister on several occasions.
ex.fr: J'ai rencontré votre sœur à plusieurs reprises.

ex.en: Community festivals provide an occasion for residents from different backgrounds to share traditions and build friendships.
ex.zh: 社区节庆让不同背景的居民有机会分享传统、建立友谊。
ex.vi: Community festivals provide an occasion for residents from different backgrounds to share traditions and build friendships.
ex.fr: Les festivals communautaires offrent aux résidents de différents horizons l'occasion de partager leurs traditions et de nouer des amitiés.

col: rise to the occasion｜rise to the occasion
tip: 表示“在某次场合”用on，不用in。
tip_vi: Để diễn đạt “vào một dịp nào đó”, hãy dùng on thay vì in.
tip_fr: Pour exprimer « à une certaine occasion », utilisez on au lieu de in.
col_zh: 成功应对挑战｜rise to the occasion
col_fr: se montrer à la hauteur｜rise to the occasion

senses.en: a relationship between people who like and support each other
senses.vi: a relationship between people who like and support each other

ex.en: Our friendship began when we shared a school desk.
ex.zh: 我们的友谊始于上学时做同桌的日子。
ex.vi: Our friendship began when we shared a school desk.
ex.fr: Notre amitié a commencé lorsque nous partagions un bureau d'école.

ex.en: Close friendship can improve mental health by providing emotional support during periods of stress.
ex.zh: 亲密的友谊可以在压力时期提供情感支持，从而改善心理健康。
ex.vi: Close friendship can improve mental health by providing emotional support during periods of stress.
ex.fr: Une amitié étroite peut améliorer la santé mentale en apportant un soutien émotionnel pendant les périodes de stress.

col: a bond of friendship｜a bond of friendship
tip: 泛指友谊不可数；具体一段友谊可数。
tip_vi: Tình bạn nói chung là không thể đếm xuể; một tình bạn cụ thể là có thể đếm được.
tip_fr: Une amitié en général est indénombrable ; une amitié spécifique est dénombrable.
col_zh: 友谊的纽带｜a bond of friendship
col_fr: un lien d'amitié｜a bond of friendship

senses.en: Working well without wasting time, energy, or resources.
senses.vi: Working well without wasting time, energy, or resources.

ex.en: Our new washing machine is quieter and more efficient.
ex.zh: 我们的新洗衣机更安静，也更节能。
ex.vi: Our new washing machine is quieter and more efficient.
ex.fr: Notre nouvelle machine à laver est plus silencieuse et plus efficace.

ex.en: An efficient public transport network allows cities to move more people while consuming less energy.
ex.zh: 高效的公共交通网络使城市能够以更低的能耗运送更多乘客。
ex.vi: An efficient public transport network allows cities to move more people while consuming less energy.
ex.fr: Un réseau de transports publics efficace permet aux villes de déplacer plus de personnes tout en consommant moins d'énergie.

col: efficient use of resources｜efficient use of resources
tip: efficient强调少浪费；effective强调达到预期效果。
tip_vi: Hiệu quả nhấn mạnh ít lãng phí hơn; hiệu quả nhấn mạnh việc đạt được kết quả mong đợi.
tip_fr: Efficace met l’accent sur moins de gaspillage ; efficace met l’accent sur l’atteinte des résultats attendus.
col_zh: 高效利用资源｜efficient use of resources
col_fr: utilisation efficace des ressources｜efficient use of resources

senses.en: the way someone or something looks
senses.vi: the way someone or something looks

senses.en: an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present
senses.vi: an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present

ex.en: A fresh coat of paint transformed the room's appearance.
ex.zh: 重新刷了一层漆，房间的面貌焕然一新。
ex.vi: A fresh coat of paint transformed the room's appearance.
ex.fr: Une nouvelle couche de peinture a transformé l'apparence de la pièce.

ex.en: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
ex.zh: 雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。
ex.vi: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
ex.fr: Les employeurs devraient évaluer les candidats sur leurs compétences et leur expérience plutôt que de les juger sur leur apparence.

col: improve the appearance of｜improve the appearance of
tip: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。
tip_vi: Ngoại hình có thể được sử dụng cho cả ngoại hình và ngoại hình; làm vẻ ngoài thường được sử dụng để chỉ sự xuất hiện.
tip_fr: L'apparence peut être utilisée à la fois pour l'apparence et l'apparence ; faire une apparition est couramment utilisé pour l'apparence.
col_zh: 改善……的外观｜improve the appearance of
col_fr: améliorer l'apparence de｜improve the appearance of

senses.en: A hard-shelled fruit with an edible seed inside.
senses.vi: A hard-shelled fruit with an edible seed inside.

senses.en: A small metal piece screwed onto a bolt to fasten things.
senses.vi: A small metal piece screwed onto a bolt to fasten things.

ex.en: She cracked a nut and shared the kernel with me.
ex.zh: 她敲开一颗坚果，把果仁分给我吃。
ex.vi: She cracked a nut and shared the kernel with me.
ex.fr: Elle a cassé une noix et a partagé le noyau avec moi.

ex.en: Nuts provide useful nutrients, although schools must consider food allergies when planning meals for children.
ex.zh: 坚果能提供有益的营养物质，但学校为儿童安排餐食时必须考虑食物过敏问题。
ex.vi: Nuts provide useful nutrients, although schools must consider food allergies when planning meals for children.
ex.fr: Les noix fournissent des nutriments utiles, même si les écoles doivent tenir compte des allergies alimentaires lors de la planification des repas des enfants.

tip: 食物和五金中的nut都是可数名词。
tip_vi: Nut in food và hardware đều là danh từ đếm được.
tip_fr: Nut dans food et hardware sont tous deux des noms dénombrables.
col_zh: 螺母和螺栓；基本细节｜nuts and bolts
